description: Case Data of Cascading Failure in CPPS is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Suhan Zhang. "Existing simulation methods for cyber-physical power systems (CPPS) often oversimplify cyber-physical interactions, particularly in time synchronisation and data exchange processes, limiting their accuracy to assess cascading failure risks. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
